To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
claudin family proteins regulate paracellular diffusion in polarized epithelia and that claudin-11 affords rapid conduction for small diameter myelin.
claudin-11 tight junctions regulate the biophysical properties and conduction of small CNS myelin sheathed axons.
claudin11 forms a radial tight junction in myelin that regulates current flow and moderates the capacitive charging of myelin.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the molecular and biophysical mechanisms of myelin function and dysfunction.
the molecular biology of myelin, and the role of claudin 1 in myelin structure and function.
the role of claudin 1 in myelination, and the effect of claudin knockout on myelinated axon conduction.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
claudin-11 is required for rapid nerve conduction in small myelinated fibers and this is due to a decrease in the capacitance of myelin.
claudin-11 tight junctions regulate the electrical properties of myelin by limiting current flow and moderating the charging of myelin capacitance.

claudin-11 forms the radial component of myelin and that it regulates the insulative properties and the biophysical properties (e.g., threshold and conduction velocity) of small diameter myelinating axons in the central nervous system.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the claudin 10/11 family of tight junction proteins is critical to the biophysical properties, and therefore the function, of the CNS myelin membrane.
claudin11 is a key regulator of the electrical properties of myelin and that this function is critical for the rapid nerve conduction of small myelinated axon.
claudin11 regulates the electrical properties of small diameter myelinating axons.
The main takeaway from our work is that
TJs are a critical component of the insulative properties that allow rapid nerve conduction.
the radial component of myelin is a critical component of the axonal insulative sheath, and that claudin-11 is a critical component that regulates ion flux through myelin.
claudin-11 tight junctions are critical for the insulative properties that allow rapid nerve conduction.
